records.claim: Morocco has appointed its first female prime minister, marking a historic milestone in the country's political landscape.
records.quote: Morocco has crossed a historic milestone after King Mohammed VI appointed Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri as the country's first female prime minister, marking a landmark moment for both the North African nation and the broader Arab world.

records.claim: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri became the first woman to serve as Prime Minister of Morocco on 29 September 2026, following her party's victory in the 2026 election.
records.quote: On 29 September 2026, she was appointed Prime Minister of Morocco by King Mohammed VI after her party won a plurality of seats in the 2026 general election.
